title: console Home: "Recently accessed" keeps a record row whose object's package is disabled, and fetches /meta/object/<name> for its icon (404)
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

Found by the hotcrm PSA lane on @object-ui/console 18.5.0 while measuring hotcrm#2561 with the Project Delivery module disabled. Read in code on objectstack `main` 3452dec219.

## What happens

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx` ~481: `recentApps` filters recent items by **type** only (`object`, `view`, `dashboard`, `page`, `record`).
2. `describeRecent` (~497) then reads the record's object by name for its icon tile: `readObjectsByName(metadata, [objectName])` (`hooks/useObjectPresence.ts` ~88). For an object whose package is disabled, that is a `GET /meta/object/<name>` answering 404, once per Home render.
3. The row still draws ("Wayne Operations Module Rollout · Project · 1 hour ago"). Clicking it opens a record page for an object the environment no longer serves.

The rule objectstack#26988 applies elsewhere (record-page lists, a dashboard's `requiresObject`, `NavigationItem`: an object the registered list does not hold is neither drawn nor asked about). It is not applied to Home's recent rows.

## Asked

A recent row whose object is not in the registered object list is not drawn and not fetched: drop it, or show it inert with no fetch. Pin it with a test that disables a package after a record of it was visited.

## Done when

With a module disabled after one of its records was opened, Home shows no row for that record (or an inert one), and the console makes no `/meta/object/<name>` request for it.

Measured: one console 404 per Home render, plus one dead row. Low severity.
